# Use private reporting

Security and privacy issues must be reported through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ryanshi1103/ai-workflow-foundry/security/advisories/new).

If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository owner through a
private verified channel listed on their GitHub profile. Follow
[`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md) and share the minimum information needed to
establish impact.

If you opened this template for a non-sensitive hardening suggestion, remove
all private details and use the Feature Request template instead.
